subject: [RFC PATCH v2 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the approach of exposing NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, suggesting it's a good way to track pages waiting for an RCU grace period.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new counter, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, to track pages waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy Update) grace period. The goal is to free these pages sooner when they hold back memory that's needed. This change affects various kernel components, including mm/page_alloc.c, mm/show_mem.c, and mm/vmstat.c.
